entries.title: Send Advocacy setup to your registration vendor or web agency
entries.summary: On an Attendees campaign's **Share** tab, **Send to your web team** emails a setup page to your registration vendor or web agency. They get the open link, the confirmation-page embeds and the personal link template, each with a copy button, and no Sessionboard login is needed. The email carries a link, not code, so email programs can't break it. The card lists who you sent it to and whether they opened it, and you can turn off any link.

where.path: Marketing → Advocacy → Attendees campaign → Share → Send to your web team

entries.use_case: An event whose registration vendor pastes the confirmation-page embed can send the vendor a setup page instead of a Share tab link that asks them to log in.

cs_action.note: For customers running an Attendees campaign whose registration is run by a vendor (Cvent, Swoogo, MCI and similar), point them at Send setup on the Share tab instead of forwarding the admin Share URL or pasting code into an email.

internal.gotchas: Only on Attendees campaigns. The signup form embed and open link appear on the setup page only while the open link is on. Turning off a setup link does not break code already pasted; turn off the open link or end the campaign for that.
internal.staff_path: Marketing → Advocacy → open an Attendees campaign → Share → Send to your web team → Send setup
internal.talk_track: You don't need to give your registration vendor a login: send them the setup page from the Share tab and they copy the code from there.
internal.when_to_bring_up: A customer's registration vendor or web agency can't open the Share tab, or embed code broke after being pasted into an email.
internal.who_should_get_it: Every customer running an Attendees Advocacy campaign whose registration platform or website is managed by someone outside their team.
